title: ToggleSprintPlus
description: Toggle Sprint, Flying Speed Multiplier, and a beautiful draggable HUD — Lunar Client style.
body:
ToggleSprintPlus is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod inspired by 
Lunar Client, designed to enhance your movement experience in Minecraft 
26.1.1 (Tiny Takeover).

Say goodbye to holding down your sprint key forever. With ToggleSprintPlus, 
simply tap Left Ctrl once and your character will sprint automatically 
without you ever needing to hold a key again. Tap it again to turn it off. 
Simple, clean, and satisfying.

For players who love flying around in creative mode or servers, the Flying 
Speed Multiplier lets you boost your flight speed up to 10x the default. 
Choose from 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x speed directly from the config 
menu. Zoom across your world in seconds.

The centerpiece of the mod is the fully draggable Lunar Client style HUD. 
It intelligently displays your current movement state — whether you are 
sprinting, sneaking, flying, or flying at a boosted speed like Flying (2x). 
Press Right Alt to enter drag mode and place the HUD anywhere on your 
screen. Customize the text color, bracket style, and background visibility 
to match your setup perfectly.

Open the config menu anytime with Left Alt to tweak every setting to your 
liking.
